messages:
natalie: publish pipeline failed: typegen produced a regen-only diff and semver guard bumped the SDK 5.2.0 -> 5.3.0. publish blocked.
ci-bot: publish-job-9001 failed: changelog.semver_check failed. Diff: 5.2.0 -> 5.3.0. Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/9001/logs
omar: i looked at the diff: property reorder + a minor ref-name normalization from the contract compiler. no semantic contract changes.
chez: this is the same circular problem we've seen: publish flow builds SDK -> runs sample-app integration (which uses the freshly-built SDK) -> runs regen -> semver check. A flaky auth/retry test retriggered the build and changed generation ordering.
natalie: two immediate asks: (1) can we stop using the fresh SDK artifact for the integration step in the publish gate? (2) can typegen do a deterministic normalization pass to ignore ordering-only changes?
omar: for (1) yes, we can pin that step to the last released tag so the gate is stable. i'll open a pipeline MR.
chez: for (2) adding a stable-sort + original-ref mapping in typegen avoids noisy diffs. i've prototyped it and will open a PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/525. It emits a "normalized-only" marker on diffs.
natalie: short-term mitigation: create a label `publish/regen-only-ok` that a release lead can apply when the diff is generator-only and reviewed. releases-bot: label `publish/regen-only-ok` created; applying requires release lead ack and a short justification in #releases.
ci-bot: artifacts saved at s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/publish/9001. changelog excerpt: "Reordered properties: Profile -> email, name"
omar: i'll prioritize the pipeline MR today to pin integration tests. chez: i'll add tests to PR #525 and a semver-guard change to consult the normalized marker so ordering-only diffs are classified as docs-only.
natalie: thanks. please document the override procedure in the release playbook and log any use in #releases. target: merge both PRs before the next release window to avoid manual overrides. :thumbsup:
